findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/review-run-start-signed-workspace-resolution-execution-plan.md:413 and docs/requirements/decisions/review-run-start-signed-workspace-resolution-execution-plan.md:518 disagree on split-root direct REVIEW behavior. The regression matrix allows a non-git wrapper root with cwd inside a nested git repo to succeed via explicit current-git-cwd, but the acceptance criteria require wrapper-root projects to fail closed until gitRoot or worktree attachment exists. Future implementation/tests cannot satisfy both semantics; severity high.
